hud.strikerTitle: Striker cocking meter: 3 clicks before detonation!

curtain.title: DM Curtain (Challenge Setup)
curtain.closeTitle: Close curtain and hand controls to player
curtain.stealthNotice: ℹ️ Lockpicks bend and break under excessive pressure. When stealth is on, rattling fills the guard alert meter.
curtain.trapNotice: ℹ️ Traps require steady hands in the active trigger zone. Fumbles advance the striker toward trigger detonation.
curtain.runesControls: Keys 1, 2, 3 — select ring; A/D or scroll wheel — rotate.
curtain.runesNotice: ℹ️ Mana radiates from the central core in 4 directions. Align conduits to connect colored elemental altars.
curtain.pickpocketNotice: ℹ️ Carefully slide the item out of the target's pocket. Jerky motions or grazing the pocket edge raise suspicion.
curtain.alchemyNotice: ℹ️ Scaled to D&D canon: potent brews demand strict temperature corridors, complex steps, and carry high spoiling risk.
curtain.handOffBtn: 📜 Hand Screen to Player (Close Curtain & Start)

help.title: 📜 Challenge Guide: {game}
help.lockGoal: Turn the cylinder all the way (90°) by finding the lock's sweet spot angle.
help.lockControls: Move mouse or finger across the canvas to aim the lockpick. Press and hold SPACE or Left Mouse Button to turn cylinder.
help.lockTip: Higher character bonus widens the sweet spot and increases pick durability. Release tension when pick shivers to avoid breaking it!
help.trapGoal: Disarm one of 4 authentic D&D traps (chosen by the DM) before the striker's 3rd click.
help.strikerRule: Critical slips advance the striker by 1 notch. On the 3rd click the trap triggers instantly!
